sections.section_title: FDCAN standard message ID filter element
sections.text_helper: Section 46.4.11 "FDCAN standard message ID filter element" in chapter 46 (FD controller area network (FDCAN)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 2051.
sections.section_content:
Up to 28 filter elements can be configured for 11-bit standard IDs. When accessing a
standard message ID filter element, its address is the filter list standard start address
FLSSA plus the index of the filter element (0 … 27).
[Table 481. Standard message ID filter element]
[Table 482. Standard message ID filter element field description]
Note: In case a reserved value is configured, the filter element is considered disabled.
